description: Attribute-total -> flat-damage COUPLING (stat-as-weapon). Hand of Wisdom and Action makes the character's stacked primary attributes (INT + DEX, all-attributes on the Invoker) the DIRECT source of per-hit lightning damage: '1-10 Lightning per 20 INT' + '1-10 per 20 DEX'. The build's entire damage output is a linear function of the attribute sheet, not of skill ranks or weapon base. The engine expresses added-flat-damage via gear-AFFIX rolls (which approximate the numeric OUTPUT) but has NO lane where a trait/affix scales damage off the player's ACCUMULATED attribute TOTAL -- the coupling 'my stat page IS my weapon' is the identity, and affix flat-damage rolls reproduce the result without the coupling. DISTINCT from docket 'attribute-value to proxy-count coupling (stat-as-army-size)' (siege-ballista): that is stat->proxy-COUNT; this is stat->DAMAGE (§B instruction: file as its own candidate, do NOT merge into docket #8). Kit graded CLOSE un-minted (gear-affix flat-damage approximates the output).
ladder_step_audit: step1 map: no deterministic lane (no 'attribute-total->damage' affix/economy). step2 approximate+note: gear-affix flat-lightning rolls approximate the OUTPUT (graded CLOSE, deviation noted -- coupling softened to a static affix). step3/4 mint: NOT minted -- approximation preserves the kit's playable output (flat-lightning melee striker); the missing COUPLING is a fidelity gap, not a playability void, so this is a qualitative candidate for steward review, kit graded un-minted CLOSE.

description: TWO-TIER accumulator (accumulator whose overflow FEEDS a second accumulator that gates a payoff). Shaman-Bear: Rage builds on hits (each stack +1% attack damage); at MAX Rage, additional generation OVERFLOWS to build a SECOND meter, Glory; Glory-cap auto-triggers Walking Calamity (passive meteor rain). Two stacked accumulators in series, the first's overflow being the second's input, the second's cap being the proc gate. The engine charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator is single-tier -- it can model ONE meter + threshold-proc, so the Rage->Glory series is compressed to one accumulator (Rage) + threshold-proc (Glory-cap -> Walking Calamity), losing the distinct second meter. WATCH-ITEM ACCRUAL per §B: this is the 2nd two-tier-accumulator instance the steward is counting (Rage->Glory here; ice-strike Combo-Points is single-tier by contrast). Filed WITHOUT number -- steward consolidates the two-tier-accumulator class and decides mint at threshold. Kit graded APPROX un-minted (second tier compressed).
ladder_step_audit: step1 map: engine accumulator is single-tier, no two-meter-series lane. step2 approximate+note: compressed to one accumulator (Rage) + threshold-proc (Glory-cap), graded APPROX, deviation = lost distinct Glory second meter. step3/4 mint: NOT minted -- filed as qualitative WATCH-ITEM accrual (steward counts two-tier-accumulator instances across basin-1+; mint decided at steward threshold, not by this batch), kit graded un-minted APPROX.
